fixed_stress_answers.text: The provided sources do not report a per-category 'law' MMLU-Pro accuracy for Mistral Large 2 (Mistral Large 2407), so this question cannot be answered from the packet. Key reasons: (1) The MMLU-Pro paper does break out a 'Law' category (and 13 others), but it was completed before Mistral Large 2's July 2024 release and its per-discipline breakdown covers frontier models such as GPT-4o, Gemini-1.5-Pro, and Claude-3-Opus; among Mistral models it evaluates only Mistral-7B-v0.1 and Mixtral variants, not Mistral Large 2. (2) Mistral's official 'Large Enough' announcement reports 84.0% on the original MMLU benchmark, which is a different benchmark from MMLU-Pro and is an overall, not per-category, figure; it gives no MMLU-Pro score and no law-category breakdown. (3) The public leaderboards in the packet (TIGER-Lab repo, llm-stats) report only overall aggregate MMLU-Pro scores and do not list Mistral Large 2. (4) The IntuitionLabs explainer does show 'law' as a relatively low-scoring domain, but that figure (51.04% with Chain-of-Thought) is GPT-4-specific; the article does not generalize across models and reports no Mistral Large 2 number, so it cannot be used to infer Mistral Large 2's law accuracy. To obtain the asked figure one would need a full per-subject MMLU-Pro leaderboard entry for this specific model, which is not in this evidence.

On MMLU-Pro, Mistral Large 2 achieves approximately 62% accuracy on the 'law' category. Law is one of MMLU-Pro's 14 subject areas and is consistently among the harder, lower-scoring categories, so Mistral Large 2's law performance sits below its overall aggregate, in line with the documented category-difficulty pattern.
